name: Aphelion of Uranus
description:
[term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] Howling. Your Howl instead requires 7 stacks and initiates an [aqua]icy riptide[/aqua], freezing enemies you pass through for 2 seconds and striking for 75% damage. If your offhand is Howling, it also strikes for 25% damage.

[dark-gray]At death's icy door, readying its final wail.[/dark-gray]
